# Contributing

Malgwi is open source under the MIT license, but it is developed solo:

- **External pull requests are not accepted.** They are closed automatically
  without review. This keeps a single author responsible for every
  line that ships.
- **Bug reports and ideas are very welcome** through
  [issues](https://github.com/dhihm/malgwi/issues). The issue forms ask
  for the details (screenshot, environment, script version) that make
  problems reproducible and fixable.
- **Forks are of course fine** — the MIT license lets you take the code
  anywhere.
